scripts.generate: openapi-typescript openapi/api-v1.yaml -o src/generated/api-v1.d.ts && js-yaml openapi/api-v1.yaml > openapi/api-v1.json
scripts.generate:check: before=$(mktemp) && after=$(mktemp) && shasum -a 256 src/generated/api-v1.d.ts openapi/api-v1.json > "$before" && npm run generate > /dev/null && shasum -a 256 src/generated/api-v1.d.ts openapi/api-v1.json > "$after" && diff "$before" "$after" && rm -f "$before" "$after" && echo 'no drift'
